questions.question:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Statement: A supermarket chain has launched a loyalty program for frequent shoppers.

Conclusions:

I. A higher number of patrons will frequent the supermarket.

II. Shopping at local convenience stores will decrease significantly.
questions.solution:
Given statement: A supermarket chain has launched a loyalty program for frequent shoppers.

Given Conclusions:

I. A higher number of patrons will frequent the supermarket. → Does not Follow

A loyalty program is introduced with the intention of attracting frequent shoppers, but it does not definitely guarantee that more patrons will frequent the supermarket. Hence, it is only a possibility, not a logically conclusion.

II. Shopping at local convenience stores will decrease significantly. → Does not Follow

There is no information suggesting that customers will stop shopping at local convenience stores, let alone that it will decrease significantly.

Thus, neither Conclusions follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Problem: Patients are expressing frustration over long waiting times at the health clinic.

Course of Action:

I. Hire additional medical staff and administrative assistants.

II. Promote the use of the clinic’s new digital booking and tele-consultation portal.
questions.solution:
Given statement: Patients are expressing frustration over long waiting times at the health clinic.

Given course of actions:

I. Hire additional medical staff and administrative assistants. → Follow

It directly tackles the cause of long waiting times by increasing staff capacity and improving service efficiency. 

II. Promote the use of the clinic’s new digital booking and tele-consultation portal. → Follow

It helps to manage patient flow by reducing unnecessary visits and streamlining appointments through digital booking and tele-consultation.

Thus, Both conclusions follow.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: A quantity is increased by 40 percent and then subsequently decreased by 40 percent. What is the net percentage change in the quantity?
questions.solution:
Given:

First percentage change (r1) = +40

Second percentage change (r2) = -40

Formula Used: Net Change % = r1 + r2 + (r1 × r2) / 100

Calculation:

Net Change % = 40 + (-40) + (40 × (-40)) / 100

⇒ Net Change % = 40 - 40 + (-1600) / 100

⇒ Net Change % = 0 - 16

⇒ Net Change % = -16

∴ The net change in the number in percentage is -16% (a decrease of 16%).

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The new digital portal launched by the electrical board allows residents to report power outages or faulty wiring.

Conclusions:

I. Residents can actively help in the upkeep of the electrical grid through the portal.

II. The electrical board no longer requires on-site maintenance crews.
questions.solution:
Given statement: The new digital portal launched by the electrical board allows residents to report power outages or faulty wiring.

Given Conclusions:

I. Residents can actively help in the upkeep of the electrical grid through the portal. → Follow

If residents can report power outrages or faulty wiring through the digital portal, they are actively participating in identifying issues and assisting in the upkeep of the electrical grid.

II. The electrical board no longer requires on-site maintenance crews. → Does not Follow

The statement does not imply that on-site maintenance crews are no longer needed. Reporting issues digitally does not replace repair work.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The municipal department has installed high-resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections.

Conclusions: I. Surveillance cameras assist in reducing traffic violations.

II. Motorists frequently ignore traffic signals at major intersections.
questions.solution:
Given statement: The municipal department has installed high-resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections.

Given Conclusions:

I. Surveillance cameras assist in reducing traffic violations. → Follow

Installing high resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections is typically done to monitor and deter violations. It is reasonable to conduct that such cameras assist in reducing traffic violations.

II. Motorists frequently ignore traffic signals at major intersections. → Does not Follow

The statement does not imply that motorists frequently ignore traffic signals. This is an assumption beyond the given information.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
